examples.name: Static underlined list
examples.description: A read-only metadata list with underline dividers between pairs.
examples.jsx:
<KeyValueList>
  <KeyValuePair label="Client name" value="Jane Doe" underline />
  <KeyValuePair label="Account type" value="Trust" underline />
  <KeyValuePair label="Status" value="Active" />
</KeyValueList>

props.children: 3 KeyValuePair (static; underline on all but the last)

examples.name: Static clean list (no underlines)
examples.description: A read-only metadata list without dividers.
examples.jsx:
<KeyValueList>
  <KeyValuePair label="Client name" value="Jane Doe" />
  <KeyValuePair label="Account type" value="Trust" />
  <KeyValuePair label="Status" value="Active" />
</KeyValueList>

examples.name: Mixed editable and static pairs
examples.description: Some pairs are editable in place (an inline TextField or TextArea in Inline Edit, with actionPlacement="end" so a row keeps its height while editing), others are static.
examples.jsx:
<KeyValueList>
  <KeyValuePair label="Client name" underline>
    <InlineEdit value={name} onConfirm={setName} actionPlacement="end">
      <TextField context="inline" aria-label="Client name" iconAfter={<EditIcon color="subtle" />} />
    </InlineEdit>
  </KeyValuePair>
  <KeyValuePair label="Account type" value="Trust" underline />
  <KeyValuePair label="Notes" underline>
    <InlineEdit value={notes} onConfirm={setNotes} actionPlacement="end" actionAlignment="start">
      <TextArea autoResize context="inline" aria-label="Notes" iconAfter={<EditIcon color="subtle" />} />
    </InlineEdit>
  </KeyValuePair>
  <KeyValuePair label="Status" value="Active" />
</KeyValueList>

props.children: 4 KeyValuePair (2 static; TextField and TextArea with context="inline" in InlineEdit actionPlacement="end")

antiExamples.name: Non-KeyValuePair children
antiExamples.reason: The <dl> element expects <dt>/<dd> children. Use KeyValuePair items inside KeyValueList.

antiExamples.name: A heading inside the list
antiExamples.reason: A <dl> can hold only <dt>/<dd> groups, so the markup isn't valid. Name the list with a heading outside it, and put only pairs inside.

antiExamples.name: Mixed sizes in one list
antiExamples.jsx:
<KeyValueList>
  <KeyValuePair size="sm" label="Account type" value="Trust" underline />
  <KeyValuePair size="lg" label="Status" value="Active" />
</KeyValueList>
antiExamples.reason: The rows change height and text size from one to the next. Give every pair in a list the same size.

antiExamples.name: Inline Edit's buttons below an editable pair
antiExamples.jsx:
<KeyValueList>
  <KeyValuePair label="Client name" underline>
    <InlineEdit value={name} onConfirm={setName}>
      <TextField context="inline" aria-label="Client name" />
    </InlineEdit>
  </KeyValuePair>
  <KeyValuePair label="Status" value="Active" />
</KeyValueList>
antiExamples.reason: With Inline Edit's default placement the row grows while editing, and the rest of the list moves down. Use actionPlacement="end" so the list doesn't shift while someone edits.
